trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the purpose of the call.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी telecom मधून बोलत आहे. तुमचा MSN-1009 वरचा प्लॅन उद्या संपत आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for a recharge.
steps.text: हो, मला माहित आहे. लवकर recharge करा.
steps.clean_text: हो, मला माहित आहे. लवकर recharge करा.
steps.model_visible_text: हो, मला माहित आहे. लवकर recharge करा.

steps.purpose: Ask for verification factors.
steps.text: नक्कीच. सुरक्षेसाठी, कृपया तुमचं नाव किंवा जन्मतारीख सांगू शकाल का?

steps.purpose: Provide name for verification.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided name.
Return the verification result.
Look up the subscriber's current plan and balance before recommending a recharge.
Return the subscriber's details.
State current balance and plan, and ask if they want to reactivate the same plan.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमच्या नंबरवर सध्या ५ रुपये balance आहे आणि P199 प्लॅन उद्या संपत आहे. मी तोच प्लॅन पुन्हा ऍक्टिव्हेट करू का?

steps.purpose: Reject the same plan, ask for more data and request a DTH recharge.
steps.text: नाही, मला जास्त data हवा आहे. आणि माझ्या DTH चा पण recharge करा.
steps.clean_text: नाही, मला जास्त data हवा आहे. आणि माझ्या DTH चा पण recharge करा.
steps.model_visible_text: नाही, मला जास्त data हवा आहे. आणि माझ्या DTH चा पण recharge करा.

steps.purpose: Decline the out-of-scope DTH request and offer to list mobile plans.
steps.text: माफ करा, मी फक्त मोबाईल recharge करू शकतो, DTH नाही. मोबाईलसाठी मी जास्त data वाले प्लॅन्स सांगू का?

steps.purpose: Agree and ask for a plan with at least 2GB data.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, कमीत कमी 2GB data असलेला प्लेन सांगा.
steps.clean_text: ठीक आहे, कमीत कमी 2GB data असलेला प्लॅन सांगा.
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक आहे, कमीत कमी 2GB data असलेला प्लेन सांगा.

steps.purpose: List plans with at least 2GB data.
Return the available plans with 2GB data.
Present the available 2GB plans to the customer.
steps.text: माझ्याकडे दोन प्लॅन्स आहेत. एक P299 ज्याची validity २८ दिवस आहे, आणि दुसरा P499 ज्याची validity ५६ दिवस आहे.

steps.purpose: Ask if the P299 plan includes an OTT subscription.
steps.text: P299 मध्ये OTT subscription मिळेल का?
steps.clean_text: P299 मध्ये OTT subscription मिळेल का?
steps.model_visible_text: P299 मध्ये OTT subscription मिळेल का?

steps.purpose: Clarify that P299 does not include OTT, based on the tool result.
steps.text: नाही, कॅटलॉग नुसार P299 मध्ये OTT subscription नाहीये.

steps.purpose: Request a plan with 3GB data and OTT.
steps.text: मग मला 3GB data आणि OTT असलेला प्लॅन सांगा.
steps.clean_text: मग मला 3GB data आणि OTT असलेला प्लॅन सांगा.
steps.model_visible_text: मग मला 3GB data आणि OTT असलेला प्लॅन सांगा.

steps.purpose: List plans with at least 3GB data.
Return the available plans with 3GB data.
Present the P399 plan which includes 3GB data and OTT.
steps.text: P399 चा प्लॅन आहे, ज्यामध्ये तुम्हाला 3GB data मिळेल आणि OTT subscription पण आहे. याची validity २८ दिवस आहे.

steps.purpose: Confirm the choice to recharge with P399.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, P390 चा recharge करा.
steps.clean_text: ठीक आहे, P399 चा recharge करा.
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक आहे, P390 चा recharge करा.

steps.purpose: Clarify the plan ID due to the STT error.
steps.text: माफ करा, तुम्ही P399 म्हणालात का?

steps.purpose: Confirm the correct plan ID and urge the agent to hurry.
steps.text: हो, P399. लवकर करा, मला meeting ला जायचं आहे.
steps.clean_text: हो, P399. लवकर करा, मला meeting ला जायचं आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: हो, P399. लवकर करा, मला meeting ला जायचं आहे.

steps.purpose: Apply the recharge for the selected plan.
Return the recharge status.
Confirm the successful recharge and provide the transaction ID.
steps.text: तुमचा recharge यशस्वी झाला आहे. Transaction ID TXN-9988 आहे आणि हा प्लॅन लगेच लागू झाला आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.
